title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: Directors, senior executives and staff members who are involved in material transactions and financial reporting concerning the Company, and anyone connected with those people.

tiers.name: all employees
tiers.description: Employees and directors not classified as Restricted Persons. Trades of $10,000 or more require the same prior written consent as Restricted Persons; there is no stated threshold or consent requirement below that value.

windows.end_anchor: day following release of half year results to the NZSX and ASX
day following release of full year results to the NZSX and ASX

rules.detail: The policy only restricts 'buy or sell' of Air New Zealand securities (shares); derivatives, options, puts, calls or other financial products are never named and there is no dealing definition to sweep them in.
No reference to hedging, limiting economic risk, or unvested equity incentive securities anywhere in the policy.
Prepaid forwards, collars or other monetisation structures are not named and are not caught by the narrow buy/sell directive.
Short selling is not named or distinguished from ordinary selling.
Securities lending is not named anywhere in the policy.
CFDs are not named and are not a derivative of 'buy or sell' shares.
Granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over shares is not mentioned and is not caught by the 'buy or sell' directive.
No provision addresses margin loans or any other secured financing arrangement in respect of the Company's securities.
No holding period, intention test or buy-sell window is stated.

clearance.approver: the Company, via the Approved Trading Procedure
clearance.evidence: Outside the Restricted Periods, all Restricted Persons must in respect of any intended trade in Air New Zealand securities, obtain the Company's prior written consent to trade, by following the Approved Trading Procedure.

clearance.approver: the Company, via the Approved Trading Procedure
clearance.evidence: If you are not a Restricted Person and intend to trade Air New Zealand shares with a total value of $10,000 or more, you must also obtain prior written consent by following the Approved Trading Procedure.

jurisdiction_overlays: NZX/Securities Markets Act (New Zealand) disclosure obligations referenced alongside ASX

bespoke_clauses.clause: no employee or director of the Company or its subsidiary companies may, directly or through other persons or entities: (a) buy or sell Air New Zealand securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The operative prohibition is confined to buying or selling shares; there is no dealing definition extending to derivatives, agreements to deal or encumbrances, so on its text an OTC put/call collar and a share-secured loan are not clearly caught, though the Company would likely still expect Approved Trading Procedure consent given the policy's insider-trading purpose.

bespoke_clauses.clause: (policy contains no reference to unvested securities, performance rights, options or equity incentive schemes)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: There is no vesting-based restriction to navigate, but also no guidance on how the Company would treat a collar over vested holdings; the outcome would depend entirely on how 'buy or sell' is interpreted case by case.

This document predates the derivatives, hedging and margin-lending language now standard in ASX-listed issuers' policies; a current version lodged more recently should be checked before relying on this silence.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If you are not a Restricted Person and intend to trade Air New Zealand shares with a total value of $10,000 or more, you must also obtain prior written consent
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Non-restricted staff below this threshold face no consent requirement at all, which is immaterial for directors/executives (who are Restricted Persons) but shows the policy's consent regime is value-triggered rather than instrument-triggered.

summary: This 2010 policy is a narrow insider-trading and share-dealing policy: it prohibits 'buying or selling' Air New Zealand securities without prior written consent under an unpublished Approved Trading Procedure, and bars Restricted Persons (directors, senior executives and connected persons) from trading at all during two annual Restricted Periods. It contains no definition of dealing extending to derivatives, hedging, encumbrance, margin lending or secured financing, and no provisions on unvested equity incentive securities, so an OTC collar and a share-secured loan are not expressly addressed either way. On a strict reading, a funded collar over vested shares may fall outside the policy's operative prohibition (which is limited to buying/selling shares), but a bank should not rely on that silence: the Company would likely expect Restricted Persons to seek consent under the Approved Trading Procedure given the policy's insider-trading rationale, and a current, updated version of the policy should be obtained and checked before proceeding, since this text predates the derivatives/financing language typical of contemporary ASX policies.
